entries.description: What RangerTrak is (a free, offline, in-browser radio log and map for CERT, ACS, SAR and ham-radio volunteer teams), the facts to get right about it, and links to its documentation and source. RangerTrak offers no MCP server, agent or API; this is documentation only.
